In this week's Autocar India Quick News, Denza brand has launched in India with Z9 GT and D9 MPV while Mahindra has updated the suspension setup for Thar Roxx and XUV 3XO CNG has scored 5 stars in BNCAP. In two-wheeler news, Hero has launched the Xtreme 125R Stealth Edition while BMW has launched a new Sport variant for the F 450 GS. Shrey Vaid has all the details.
